verdict.rationale: Pigment documents an official MCP server through which teams can ask business questions from ChatGPT or Claude and get answers 'grounded in your business truth'. Variance analysis and scenarios run in the platform's own modeling engine, so the core of agent-asked finance questions answered from platform data is claimed. However, the evidence never states that MCP answers return engine-computed figures with calculation lineage. The block-level history covers edit events, not provenance of the numbers. missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent answers return engine-calculated figures rather than LLM-generated ones, per-answer lineage or traceability to model formulas and source data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
